'''Clynn''' was an Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was stationed on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==Biography==
During his tour at the base, Clynn met a newly rotated-in officer named [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]], and immediately had a confrontation with him&mdash;ostensibly over taking Clynn's bunk, but in reality to show the new 'meat' who was in charge.

Sunber, however, proved more than a match for Clynn's brutish fighting style, earning the lieutenant's respect by standing up for himself and being identified as one of the 'heroes' of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. Clynn took Sunber under his wing, introducing him to life on the base, and one of the 'perks' of being an officer&mdash;being free to take advantage of female prisoners.

After being forced by Sunber&mdash;at blaster-point&mdash;to release [[Unidentified Jabiimi prisoner|his prisoner]], Clynn reported the incident, minus key details, to their commanding officer, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kale Roshuir]]. This resulted in Sunber being confined to base while its troops were mobilized to investigate a possible [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base in the [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] system.

Accompanying Captain Roshuir to Thila, Clynn was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a booby trap left behind in the abandoned Rebel base.
